The Soma Institute is located in the heart of Downtown Chicago, Illinois. This institution is a pioneer in the clinical massage therapy field and currently launching the next big thing, a Health & Wellness Coaching Certificate Program. To learn more view our website, soma.edu!


We offer three diploma programs. Soma's 700 clock hour Clinical Massage Therapy diploma program adheres to high academic standards and exceeds municipal and most state licensing requirements. Graduates receive a diploma in Clinical Massage Therapy. Soma's 300 clock hour Master Clinical Massage Therapy Program is designed to expand upon the clinical abilities attained in our undergraduate program (or other qualifying programs). Soma’s 110 clock hour Health and Wellness Coaching Certificate Program is a new program which models the professional relationship that is essential to becoming an effective health and wellness coach.
